source_text: High-quality systematic reviews and meta-analyses have countered claims of diminished penile sensitivity or sexual dysfunction post-circumcision, finding no adverse effects on sexual function, sensation, or satisfaction in circumcised versus uncircumcised men, with some evidence of reduced premature ejaculation. [141]
